quotes.text: "Full message content should match the original after download"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The test converts the partial message to HTML, checks banner/link and UIDL fields, then opens the extracted href through a channel. It checks fake POP commands and compares a nonpartial message’s normalized raw contents. It does not click rendered UI, check a live accessible link or assert that every old partial header has been removed when the complete one is found. Those are distinct from this static test intent; no test ran.
title: The POP partial-download test opens a MIME-generated URL and checks a complete message, not a live link click
